abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.
